name: fluencircle-website
description: Site do FluenCircle: sessões de conversação e flashcards com revisão espaçada (HTML, CSS e JavaScript sem build).

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator.json --project demo-fluencircle-audit --only database "node scripts/test-rules.mjs --driver=emulator"
scripts.test:e2e:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator.json --project demo-fluencircle-audit --only auth,database,hosting "npm run emulators:seed && npm run emulators:verify && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/e2e-emulator/*.test.mjs"
scripts.emulators: npm run css:build && firebase emulators:start --config firebase.emulator.json --project demo-fluencircle-audit
scripts.serve: npm run css:build && python3 -m http.server 5501 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory public
scripts.bench:pages: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator.json --project demo-fluencircle-audit --only auth,database "node scripts/benchmarks/page-performance.mjs"
